# wso2is_user (Data Source)

Looks up a user by ID or username.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wso2is_user" "admin" {
  username = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) User ID.
- `user_store` (String) User store domain of `username`. The default is `PRIMARY`.
- `username` (String) Username (without the user store prefix).

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) Primary email.
- `family_name` (String) Last name.
- `given_name` (String) First name.
- `group_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the user's groups.
- `role_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the user's roles (including through groups).
